WITH hoje AS (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date AS d),
ev AS (
  SELECT co.name AS empresa, e.status, e.event_date, e.total_value, e.lead_id, e.data_fechamento_venda, e.unit, e.start_time, e.company_id
  FROM public.company_events e JOIN public.companies co ON co.id = e.company_id
  WHERE e.event_date >= '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT 'festas_status' AS item, empresa, status AS chave, count(*)::text AS valor FROM ev GROUP BY empresa, status
UNION ALL SELECT 'festas_passadas_sem_realizar', empresa, string_agg(DISTINCT status, '/'), count(*)::text FROM ev, hoje WHERE ev.event_date < hoje.d AND status NOT IN ('realizado', 'cancelado') GROUP BY empresa
UNION ALL SELECT 'festas_sem_valor', empresa, '', count(*)::text FROM ev WHERE (total_value IS NULL OR total_value = 0) AND status <> 'cancelado' GROUP BY empresa
UNION ALL SELECT 'festas_sem_unidade', empresa, '', count(*)::text FROM ev WHERE unit IS NULL AND status <> 'cancelado' GROUP BY empresa
UNION ALL SELECT 'festas_sem_horario', empresa, '', count(*)::text FROM ev WHERE start_time IS NULL AND status <> 'cancelado' GROUP BY empresa
UNION ALL SELECT 'mesmo_dia_hora_unidade', empresa, '', count(*)::text FROM (SELECT empresa FROM ev WHERE status <> 'cancelado' AND start_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY empresa, company_id, event_date, start_time, unit HAVING count(*) > 1) x GROUP BY empresa
UNION ALL SELECT 'pre_reservas_status', co.name, p.status, count(*)::text FROM public.pre_reservations p JOIN public.companies co ON co.id = p.company_id GROUP BY co.name, p.status
UNION ALL SELECT 'visitas_status', co.name, v.status_visita, count(*)::text FROM public.lead_visits v JOIN public.companies co ON co.id = v.company_id WHERE v.data_visita >= '2026-06-01' GROUP BY co.name, v.status_visita
UNION ALL SELECT 'visitas_passadas_sem_resultado', co.name, '', count(*)::text FROM public.lead_visits v JOIN public.companies co ON co.id = v.company_id, hoje WHERE v.data_visita < hoje.d AND v.status_visita IN ('agendada', 'confirmada', 'remarcada') GROUP BY co.name
UNION ALL SELECT 'tarefas', co.name, coalesce(t.status, '?') || CASE WHEN t.completed THEN ' (feita)' ELSE '' END, count(*)::text FROM public.company_tasks t JOIN public.companies co ON co.id = t.company_id GROUP BY co.name, t.status, t.completed
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3
